stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard job [-h] {start,status} ...

A restart can kill a background run silently. `job start NAME -- COMMAND...`
runs it detached in its own session and records it under the shared temp dir
(or $FLEET_JOBS_DIR); `job status NAME` prints one line: alive, finished (with
its exit code and the result file) or dead (killed, no exit code). A job found
dead that nobody asked about is reported once to its starter's boss.

positional arguments:
  {start,status}
    start         Start a command detached and record it
    status        One line: alive, finished (exit code, result file) or dead
                  (killed, no exit code)

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
